lines.zh: 我拖着砖壳在沙上磨，一寸一寸地挪。
lines.en: I drag my brick shell across the sand, an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 壳底刮过砾石，声音像一把钝锯。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the gravel with the sound of a dull saw.

lines.zh: 潮水推我一下，我顺势滑了半格。
lines.en: The tide nudges me, and I slide half a block along.

lines.zh: 身后那条黏液痕，是我写的路标。
lines.en: The slime trail behind me is the road sign I write.

lines.zh: 青苔做的脚，走起来又软又慢。
lines.en: My mossy foot walks soft and terribly slow.

lines.zh: 别催，蜗牛的每一步都算数。
lines.en: Do not rush me; every snail step counts.

lines.zh: 沙地太松，我的壳总往下陷。
lines.en: The sand is loose, and my shell keeps sinking.

lines.zh: 我沿着海床爬，头顶是整片海。
lines.en: I crawl the seabed with the whole sea overhead.

lines.zh: 一只海龟经过，比我快一整个下午。
lines.en: A turtle passed me and gained a whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 壳太重，可我从来不想卸下它。
lines.en: The shell is heavy, and I never wish to shed it.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，藻类会晚一点长。
lines.en: Algae grows a little later wherever I have passed.

lines.zh: 红光从水面漏下来，我背着走。
lines.en: Red light leaks from the surface, and I carry it.

lines.zh: 两块砖壳并排，就是我们的小路。
lines.en: Two brick shells side by side make our own little lane.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，所以看得清每粒沙。
lines.en: I walk slowly, so I see every grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让一只蟹从壳上过去
lines.en: I stop and let a crab cross my shell.

lines.zh: 壳缝里长出的藻，又被我蹭掉了
lines.en: Algae grows in my shell's seams; I scrape it off again.

lines.zh: 我把眼柄缩回壳里，听水流过。
lines.en: I pull my eyestalks in and listen to the water.

lines.zh: 壳上的砖纹，是海水泡出来的。
lines.en: The brick pattern on my shell was soaked in by seawater.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，假装自己是一块砖。
lines.en: I stay still and pretend to be one brick.

lines.zh: 几根海草挂在我背上，我不介意。
lines.en: A few seagrasses hang on my back; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 呼吸很轻，鳃在壳缝里慢慢开合。
lines.en: My gills open and close slowly in the shell gap.

lines.zh: 我在等潮向改变，那样省力。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to turn; that saves effort.

lines.zh: 壳里很暗，正好想些慢事情。
lines.en: It is dark in my shell, good for slow thoughts.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼啄我的壳，我当没感觉。
lines.en: A small fish pecks my shell; I pretend not to feel it.

lines.zh: 我数着沙粒落下，数到第七就忘了。
lines.en: I count falling sand grains and forget at seven.

lines.zh: 砖缝里塞着一点旧海藻的味道。
lines.en: An old seaweed smell is stuck in my brick seams.

lines.zh: 我不做梦，壳里只有水声。
lines.en: I do not dream; there is only water sound inside.

lines.zh: 阳光斜着照进来，我在壳里打盹。
lines.en: Sunlight slants in, and I doze inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙里，只留眼柄。
lines.en: I bury myself in sand with only eyestalks out.

lines.zh: 这块礁石我占了三天，还没挪窝。
lines.en: I have held this rock three days without moving.

lines.zh: 两根眼柄一起转向你，慢慢的。
lines.en: Both eyestalks turn toward you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的光了，请往左一点。
lines.en: You are blocking my light; please step left.

lines.zh: 水里太浑，我只认出你的轮廓。
lines.en: The water is murky; I only make out your outline.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩在我前面的沙上。
lines.en: Your boots land on the sand just ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，壳差点翻过去。
lines.en: I look up at you and nearly tip my shell.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，我有点紧张。
lines.en: You crouch down, and I feel a little nervous.

lines.zh: 别用手指戳，我的眼柄会缩。
lines.en: Do not poke me; my eyestalks will retract.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的黏液痕断了。
lines.en: You stand too close, and my slime trail breaks.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声，比昨天重。
lines.en: I know your footsteps; they are heavier than yesterday.

lines.zh: 你走开后，我会继续看那块石头。
lines.en: After you leave, I will go back to watching that stone.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一条缝，海水钻了进去。
lines.en: A crack opens in my shell, and seawater seeps in.

lines.zh: 疼来得慢，退得也慢。
lines.en: The pain arrives slowly and leaves just as slowly.

lines.zh: 你敲碎了一角砖纹，我记着这声音。
lines.en: You chip my brick pattern, and I keep that sound.

lines.zh: 我的眼柄缩到底了，还是疼。
lines.en: My eyestalks retract fully, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 壳里那点软肉没有地方可躲。
lines.en: The soft flesh in my shell has nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 黏液止不住，顺着破口往外流。
lines.en: Slime will not stop and runs out of the break.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更想缩成一粒沙。
lines.en: This blow makes me wish I were a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我听见自己壳里传出空响。
lines.en: I hear a hollow sound ring inside my shell.

lines.zh: 别踢第二次，我修壳要修一年。
lines.en: Do not kick again; repairing my shell takes a year.

lines.zh: 我疼得动不了，只能贴住沙。
lines.en: I hurt too much to move and press into the sand.

lines.zh: 海草的味道飘过来，我慢半拍。
lines.en: The smell of seagrass drifts over, and I lag behind.

lines.zh: 你把菜叶放下，我得爬很久。
lines.en: You put down a leaf, and reaching it will take hours.

lines.zh: 我不追食物，我等食物漂过来。
lines.en: I never chase a meal; I let the current deliver it.

lines.zh: 桶里的水声，比海草更让我在意。
lines.en: The water sloshing in your bucket interests me more.

lines.zh: 那块藻垫正好，我要爬上去吃。
lines.en: That algae mat is perfect; I will crawl up and eat.

lines.zh: 你晃着水桶，我的眼柄跟着晃。
lines.en: You sway the bucket, and my eyestalks sway with it.

lines.zh: 饿是慢的，我的饿也是慢的。
lines.en: Hunger is slow, and my hunger is slow too.

lines.zh: 我闻到了碎礁石上的咸味。
lines.en: I smell salt on the broken reef rock.

lines.zh: 别把食物丢太远，我追不上。
lines.en: Do not toss the food too far; I cannot catch up.

lines.zh: 给我一片海藻，我可以陪你一下午。
lines.en: Give me one seaweed leaf and I will stay all afternoon.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的壳，脚趾会先疼。
lines.en: You kick my shell, and your toe will hurt first.

lines.zh: 我像块砖，撞上来不会让路。
lines.en: I am like a brick; I will not move aside.

lines.zh: 壳被推得歪了，我慢慢摆正。
lines.en: My shell tips sideways, and I slowly level it.

lines.zh: 你的船底刮过我，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Your boat hull scraped me, and I flinched inward.

lines.zh: 别踩，我的壳里还有我正在想的事。
lines.en: Do not step on me; I have thoughts inside this shell.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，两个人都很慢。
lines.en: We bump together, and both of us are slow.

lines.zh: 壳沿磕在礁石上，缺了一小块。
lines.en: My shell rim chipped a small piece on the reef.

lines.zh: 你用肩膀顶我，像推一堵矮墙。
lines.en: You shoulder me like pushing a low wall.

lines.zh: 水波把我们挤到同一处沙上。
lines.en: The current squeezes us onto the same patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我退开半寸，这已经算让路了。
lines.en: I back off half an inch; that counts as yielding.

lines.zh: 两只砖壳贴在一起，慢慢磨。
lines.en: Two brick shells press together, grinding slowly.

lines.zh: 它在我壳边留下一条更亮的黏液。
lines.en: It leaves a brighter slime line along my shell.

lines.zh: 我们不急，产卵的事可以等潮水。
lines.en: We are in no hurry; the eggs can wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 它用眼柄碰我的眼柄，就算答应了。
lines.en: Its eyestalk touches mine, and that is a yes.

lines.zh: 成对的壳在沙上并排，像两块砖。
lines.en: Paired shells lie side by side like two bricks.

lines.zh: 我们交换壳上的藻，算是礼物。
lines.en: We trade the algae on our shells as gifts.

lines.zh: 它比我快一点，我还是追上了。
lines.en: It is a little faster, and I still caught up.

lines.zh: 潮水退时，我们把卵埋进湿沙。
lines.en: When the tide falls, we bury eggs in wet sand.

lines.zh: 我不唱情歌，我只敲壳。
lines.en: I do not sing love songs; I only tap my shell.

lines.zh: 明天它还会在这块礁石等我。
lines.en: Tomorrow it will wait for me at this reef again.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用腹足把东西卷住。
lines.en: I have no hands, only a foot to curl around things.

lines.zh: 你把我装进桶里，我贴住桶底。
lines.en: You put me in a bucket, and I cling to its bottom.

lines.zh: 掉下来的贝壳，我挪过去盖住。
lines.en: A fallen shell drops; I crawl over and cover it.

lines.zh: 那块小石子卡在我壳边，我带走了。
lines.en: That pebble is stuck in my shell rim; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，你得等着。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly, so you will have to wait.

lines.zh: 桶里的水一晃，我抓紧了桶壁。
lines.en: The bucket water sloshes, and I grip the wall.

lines.zh: 你递来的海草，我用嘴一点点啃。
lines.en: I nibble the seagrass you offer, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖不动，只能放弃。
lines.en: It is too heavy; I cannot drag it and give up.

lines.zh: 壳是我的家，谁也别想拿走。
lines.en: My shell is my home; nobody gets to take it.

lines.zh: 被装进桶时，我还在看海的方向。
lines.en: As you bucket me, I still watch the direction of the sea.

lines.zh: 你踩出的沙坑，我想去看看。
lines.en: I want to go look at the pit your boot made.

lines.zh: 前面有块新礁石，我决定过去。
lines.en: There is a new rock ahead, and I decide to go.

lines.zh: 一条死鱼沉下来，我慢慢转向它。
lines.en: A dead fish sinks down, and I slowly turn toward it.

lines.zh: 水里的咸味变了，我抬起头。
lines.en: The salt in the water changed, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我锁定的东西通常不会跑。
lines.en: The things I lock onto usually do not run.

lines.zh: 你在我路上，我就把你当路。
lines.en: You are on my path, so I treat you as the path.

lines.zh: 那片海草动了，我改了方向。
lines.en: That patch of seagrass moved, and I change course.

lines.zh: 我没有什么要追的，除了潮线。
lines.en: I have nothing to chase except the tide line.

lines.zh: 壳里的小石子响了一下，我停住。
lines.en: The pebble in my shell clicks, and I stop.

lines.zh: 很远的地方有光，我朝那边挪。
lines.en: There is light far away, and I crawl toward it.

lines.zh: 我把目光放在你的鞋尖上。
lines.en: I keep my gaze on the tip of your boot.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就前进半寸。
lines.en: You step back one pace; I advance half an inch.

lines.zh: 我在算我们之间的距离，很慢。
lines.en: I am calculating the distance between us, slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我壳上，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，绕路要多花一天。
lines.en: I will not circle around; that costs an extra day.

lines.zh: 你站在我的黏液痕上，我停住了。
lines.en: You stand on my slime trail, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我的眼柄分开看，一只盯你一只看海。
lines.en: My eyestalks split: one on you, one on the sea.

lines.zh: 等你不动了，我再靠近一点。
lines.en: When you stop moving, I will come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我盯了很久，久到你换了姿势。
lines.en: I stared so long that you changed posture.

lines.zh: 目标太远，我决定换一块石头。
lines.en: The target is too far, so I choose another stone.

lines.zh: 我咬不动你，壳沿只磕到你的靴子。
lines.en: I cannot bite you; my shell rim only knocks your boot.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很小，最多啃下一点皮。
lines.en: My mouth is tiny and can nibble only a little skin.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，像一块砖慢慢倒下。
lines.en: I ram you like a brick slowly falling over.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我唯一会的攻击是缩起来。
lines.en: Do not push me; my only attack is retracting.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口沙，水立刻变浑了。
lines.en: I spit out a mouthful of sand and cloud the water.

lines.zh: 这一下没有力气，只有壳的重量。
lines.en: There is no strength in this blow, only shell weight.

lines.zh: 你推我，我把黏液蹭到你手上。
lines.en: You shove me; I smear slime onto your hand.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只有一条刮藻的舌头。
lines.en: I have no teeth, only a tongue for scraping algae.

lines.zh: 壳尖顶到你，算是我的全部反抗。
lines.en: My shell tip pokes you; that is all my resistance.

lines.zh: 我打不赢，只好缩回壳里等。
lines.en: I cannot win, so I retreat into my shell and wait.

lines.zh: 海洋给足了我位置，我在这里成壳。
lines.en: The ocean gives me room, and I grow my shell here.

lines.zh: 我和另一只一起出生，壳还软。
lines.en: I spawned with one other, my shell still soft.

lines.zh: 沙里埋了一夜，天亮时我才钻出来。
lines.en: Buried in sand all night, I emerge at dawn.

lines.zh: 一窝只有一两只，我们很安静。
lines.en: Only one or two per clutch, and we are quiet.

lines.zh: 海水的咸味把砖纹一点点烧上壳。
lines.en: Salt water slowly burns the brick pattern onto me.

lines.zh: 我落在一块旧砖礁旁，颜色正合适。
lines.en: I landed by an old brick reef of the right color.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋里出来时，我第一件事是找沙。
lines.en: Out of the spawn egg, I first look for sand.

lines.zh: 这片海床很挤，我还是占了一角。
lines.en: This seabed is crowded, and I still claim a corner.

lines.zh: 我生来就慢，连出生也是慢慢爬出来。
lines.en: I was born slow and crawled out even slower.

lines.zh: 潮水把我带到浅处，我就住下了。
lines.en: The tide carried me shallow, and I settled here.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，砖纹在剥落。
lines.en: My shell heats up, and the brick pattern peels.

lines.zh: 我从高处翻落，壳先着地。
lines.en: I tumble from a height, shell landing first.

lines.zh: 水太多也会淹，我在壳里憋着。
lines.en: Too much water drowns me; I hold it inside.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，壳口朝了天。
lines.en: The blast flips me over with my shell facing sky.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，我拖着它走。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shell, and I drag it.

lines.zh: 紫色的咒语钻进砖缝，很凉。
lines.en: Purple magic crawls into my seams, cold and sharp.

lines.zh: 藻越来越少，壳也变轻了。
lines.en: Algae grows scarce, and my shell feels lighter.

lines.zh: 雷劈在浅滩，我的砖壳在响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows, and my shell rings.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，壳再也蹭不到沙。
lines.en: I fall, and my shell will never scrape sand again.
